verdict.rationale: Shipping as an importable library from a package registry is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Unreal Engine installing from a package registry as a dependency you can import, bundle, or tree-shake. The evidence describes an editor-centric C++ workflow compiled with Visual Studio or Xcode. A community remark about old HTML5 export is output targeting, not registry-based library consumption.

support.subject: As a web developer, the engine installs from a package registry into my existing toolchain — a library I import, bundle, and tree-shake like any dependency
